states.source: has exemplar data; needs a `build:` mapping (or query tuning) in config.yaml
states.incomplete: missing exemplar data or a layer schema — not yet buildable
states.placeholder: name reserved; no model content yet
states.hosted: a hosted Ada model: create it from spec.json with ada_create_model and stream data/*.jsonl through POST /ada/load (or the SDK's stream); nothing runs locally

english.description: The English base for Ada: 77,818 WordNet words with synonyms and neighbours as sets. A text role that names it as `base` scores a word close to its neighbours with no language model in the path.

bfcl.description: BFCL function router — routes NL queries to the correct function via weighted-layer HDC cosine. 2724 exemplars, 75 functions. The golden path: builds end-to-end with `glyphh models build bfcl/`.

toolrouter.description: SaaS tool router — routes NL requests to 38 SaaS tool functions (slack, stripe, jira, …). Builds by convention; routes correctly on spot checks.

firewall.description: Prompt-injection firewall — 232 attack/benign exemplars over 18 labels. Builds, but its query mapping needs tuning before scores are meaningful.

churn.description: Churn-risk classifier. Exemplar fields don't match role names — needs a `build:` mapping in config.yaml.

deals.description: Deal-stage router. Needs a `build:` mapping in config.yaml.

marketing.description: Marketing intent router. Needs a `build:` mapping in config.yaml.

pipedream.description: Pipedream app/action router (large exemplar corpus). Needs a `build:` mapping in config.yaml.

faq.description: FAQ matcher — config.yaml predates the layer schema (no layers declared).

code.description: Code navigation model — no layer schema and no committed exemplar data.

sentinel.description: Sentinel anomaly model — layer schema present, no exemplar data committed.

voice.description: Voice intent model — layer schema present, no exemplar data committed.

iris.description: README only — no model content yet.
